source: assets/simulation/champion-kits.v1.json (Riot Games Data Dragon ability descriptions) plus scripts/game-data/ability-archetypes.curated.json
cooldownSec: Cooldown in seconds at the middle rank of the kit's list (rank 3 of 5, rank 2 of 3); null when that cooldown is 0.

rangeClass.rule: Kit range at the middle rank, in game units; a map-wide text promotes it to global.

noEffect: Abilities with an empty list fit none of the terms; each is listed with its reason under `noEffect` in the curated file.

origin.rule: the keyword rules alone produced the archetypes

archetypes.ally_shield: Gives another allied champion a shield.
archetypes.ally_heal: Restores health to another allied champion.
archetypes.self_heal: Heals only the caster (drains and sustain abilities included).
archetypes.ally_buff: Strengthens another allied champion without shielding or healing it (speed, damage, attack speed, resistances).
archetypes.self_buff: Strengthens the caster for a time or changes how it fights: attack speed, attack damage, range, resistances, movement speed, empowered next attack, stacking abilities, stance, weapon and form switches.
archetypes.dash: Moves the caster quickly over a short distance (dashes, leaps, blinks, shadow swaps).
archetypes.engage: A gap closer or long-range tool whose purpose is to start a fight on an enemy, with crowd control on arrival.
archetypes.hard_cc: Stops an enemy from acting: stun, root, knock-up or knock-back, suppression, charm, fear, taunt, sleep, polymorph.
archetypes.soft_cc: Hinders an enemy without stopping it: slow, silence, blind, disarm, ground, cripple, nearsight.
archetypes.damage: Damage kind: deals damage to enemies and is neither poke nor execute (the ordinary damaging ability, single target or area).
archetypes.poke: Damage kind: damage from well beyond attack range (900 or more) with no dash, engage or hard crowd control on the same ability.
archetypes.execute: Damage kind: damage that grows with the target's missing health, or kills below a threshold.
archetypes.zone: Leaves something on the ground that lasts and affects those who stay in it or cross it: damaging or slowing areas, traps, walls and terrain.
archetypes.summon: Creates a unit that fights or blocks on its own (pets, turrets, clones, plants).
archetypes.untargetable: The caster or an ally cannot be targeted or damaged for a moment (stasis, invulnerability, attaching to an ally).
archetypes.global: Reaches across the map (an ability can be global and something else).
